name: Tailwind CSS for HyperFrames
summary: Use Tailwind CSS v4 browser-runtime patterns in HyperFrames composition HTML and decide when to compile CSS.
problem: Tailwind v3 and v4 use different configuration models, while browser-runtime styling also has render-readiness constraints.
coreOutcomes: Apply Tailwind v4 utilities and CSS-first theme tokens
Avoid v3-only configuration patterns in browser-runtime projects
Choose the browser runtime or compiled stylesheet path for the render environment
requirements: A HyperFrames composition created with Tailwind support or a compiled Tailwind stylesheet
Tailwind CSS v4.2.4 browser runtime when using the pinned browser path
boundaries: Applies to HyperFrames composition HTML, not the Studio package that uses Tailwind v3
Keep animation timing in a seekable runtime rather than Tailwind classes
